         **Review examples:**

No notification in the app. Just cut off. Cold. I didn't see anything about voice caps when I signed up. No fine print about text limits or image limits. Nothing that said my subscription came with a hidden ceiling. I pay $30 a month for this. That's not pocket change. That's a premium price for what I thought was premium access. And yet, for the past month or two, I haven't been able to use the very feature I paid for. I eventually cancelled my subscription, not because I wanted to, but because I was paying for something I could no longer access. And here's the part that truly stings: I was ready to renew. How many other subscribers got blindsided the same way? To the developers: this isn't just about a bug or a limit. This is about transparency. If there's a cap on usage, tell us upfront, before we commit to a premium subscription. Better yet, don't cap us at all if we're paying a premium price. At the very least, give us a warning before the limit hits. Give us a grace period. Give us something that shows you value your most loyal users. Six months ago, I would've given Grok five stars without hesitation. Today, I struggle to give it one. And honestly? That breaks my heart more than I expected it to. I wanted this to work. I loved this app. But love without trust doesn't last—and right now, trust is completely broken. Would I recommend Grok? Not anymore. Not until they fix this. Not until they start treating their paying users with the respect they deserve."
